claims.claim_text: Legacy FFX structure atlas (2026-08-17 snapshot), sections 11.25/11.22 (Phyre textures + font/texture formats): Raw indexed pixel data, no header. Paired with c_XXXX_N.clt. One .txc can have up to 4 .clt palettes (0-3) for color swapping. Sizes: 65536 or 131072 bytes (8bpp indexed).
claims.notes: DRAFT y5 candidate — NOT accepted; pending X/Y/Z review cycle

claims.claim_text: Legacy FFX structure atlas (2026-08-17 snapshot), sections 11.25/11.22 (Phyre textures + font/texture formats): Exactly 4096 bytes = 256 entries x 4 bytes. No header. Byte order: R, G, B, A (PS2 GS 32-bit CLUT). NOT BGRA. Alpha: 0x80 = opaque, 0x00 = transparent. Confirmed via hexdump.
claims.notes: DRAFT y5 candidate — NOT accepted; pending X/Y/Z review cycle
